questions.text: Where do Grain Suppliers deliver raw grain in AWP's supply chain?
questions.explanation: Grain Suppliers deliver raw grain to the Yanbou Hub, where it is processed into feed by the Feed Mills.

questions.text: What do DOC Suppliers provide to AWP?
options: Day-Old Chicks to broiler and parent rearing farms
questions.explanation: DOC Suppliers provide Day-Old Chicks (DOC) to broiler and parent rearing farms.

questions.text: How many Feed Mills does AWP operate?
questions.explanation: AWP operates 5 feed mills: Feed Mill – Watania 1, Feed Mill 3 – Watania 2, Feed Mill 6 – Watania 2, Feed Mill 4 – Wadi, and Feed Mill 5 – Wadi.

questions.text: What is the role of Grading Stations in the supply chain?
options: Raise parent-stock pullets from day-old chicks
Produce Day-Old Chicks from incubated eggs
Sort and grade hatching eggs; forward accepted eggs to hatcheries
Package finished egg products for sale
questions.explanation: Grading Stations receive hatching eggs from parent laying farms, sort and grade them, and forward accepted eggs to hatcheries. Rejected eggs are handled as by-products.

questions.text: What is the primary function of Parent Rearing Farms?
options: Raise parent-stock pullets from DOC to laying age
questions.explanation: Parent Rearing Farms raise parent-stock pullets (young hens) from day-old chicks to laying age.

questions.text: What does GP Cross Company supply to AWP?
questions.explanation: GP Cross Company is a separate legal entity that supplies Grand Parent (GP) stock to AWP's parent rearing farms.

questions.text: After broiler farms, where are broiler chickens sent?
questions.explanation: Broiler farms raise chickens for approximately 27 days, then transfer them to Processing Plants for slaughter and primary processing.

questions.text: Which operation is separate from the broiler stream and focuses on egg production?
questions.explanation: Commercial Layer operations are a separate stream focused on egg production, consisting of Layer Rearing followed by Layer Laying.
